entries.back_en: Soniel, 13th Emperor of the Fou Empire / "Yuna...I say, are you there, Yuna?"
"Yuna...I say, are you there, Yuna?"
"It...It would appear that something is happening...Would it not, Yuna?"
"Yuna!"
"Are you certain we don't need guards? We fear for our safety!"
entries.note: 'surround our self with guards' simplified to 'need guards', meaning preserved.

entries.back_en: "Well, Highness...I'm afraid all the guards in the world wouldn't make a difference should the God Emperor appear."
"Besides, I am ever your faithful and devoted servant, and I will shed my blood if needed, protecting you by imprisoning the Emperor in a web of magic. Please, Highness, rest your heart!"
entries.note: 'lay down my life'→'shed my blood' close; typo 'derramerei'.

entries.back_en: "Well! If it isn't [04][06], the God Emperor...Allow me to congratulate you on your triumphant return, Your Majesty. I..."
"Well! I'm afraid I can't let you through, Majesty."
"Today, your journey ends here. Don't worry -- we will seal your power and return you to your place of rest."
"Well! I suppose I should have imagined...It would appear that here, in this castle you built, your powers have fully restored."
"We...I have been awaiting your return, oh Great Lord..."
"Thou hast forgotten our promise...Thou hast not fulfilled the promise."
"M...Majesty, how can you say that!? Of course we have not forgotten! Now that you have returned, the Empire is yours! I would never think..."
"Wah ha ha ha! This is [09]V! I did it! I killed a god!"
"Ha ha ha ha ha! What of your promise now!? It is old and meaningless...Just like you! All this belongs to me now!!"
"Ha ha...Ha ha ha ha! / "Foolish mortal!"
"...... / ..." / "Thou art come at last...Thou who art my other self..."
entries.note: 'art me' rendered as 'my other self', acceptable.

entries.back_en: Same as above.
"Thou art come at last...Thou who art my other self..."
"But what is this? These...mortals thou hast brought with thee have no business here."
entries.note: 'Mas qual é isto?' awkward; should be 'Mas o que é isto?'.

entries.back_en: "Come...Come hither, thou who art my other self..."
"Whither goest thou? I am here."
"Discard that shell of flesh thou wearest and free thy spirit! Join with me!"
"...Yes! Come to me! Then...Then, we shall bid farewell to this wretched world."
"It seemed that thou hast lived among the mortals far too much..."
entries.note: 'Parecia' is past tense (should be 'Parece'); 'demasiado' loses 'too long'.

entries.back_en: "We must sever thy ties with this world...Untangle the paths that have tangled...I shall await thee,"
"My business lies elsewhere..."
"Very well. We are counting on you, Yuna."
